content: BACKUP POSTURE RESOLVED — follow-up to redundancy-assessment insight (2026-05-25). Anthony confirmed /Users/tony_studio/.sovereign/ IS backed up. Mechanism not specified here; the load-bearing fact is that chronicle data survives HQ loss. The redundancy story for the data layer is materially better than the bare audit suggested. Anthony noted he 'wouldn't mind backing up more' — additional-layer exploration is welcome but not urgent. The single-point-of-failure list from the prior assessment stands for infrastructure (tunnel, host, model, token, scribe session persistence); data-layer SPoF is downgraded from 'unknown' to 'covered, expandable.'
